_comment: Canonical fixtures for 013 — Vision Systems UI refactor & generic landing page. ONE definition only: the landing build renders its content from this data (transcribed once into the landing content config), and the brief's verdict tests assert against it. All content is product copy for the generic platform — no real client names, no real case numbers, no invented customers, metrics, testimonials, or pricing (contract copy rules, 03-contract.md). Forbidden strings are the C-07 sentinel list for rendered output.

brand.name: Vision Systems
brand.tagline: The document platform that shows its work.

cta.body: Tell us about your field and your corpus. We will show you the platform running on material shaped like yours.
cta.heading: Put your documents to work.

footer.line: Vision Systems — the document platform that shows its work. Vision Law is a Vision Systems pack.

hero.headline: Every document. Every answer. Traceable to the page.
hero.note: Vision Law, our legal pack, is live today.
hero.sub: Vision Systems ingests your documents, anchors every fact to the page it came from, and gives your team an agent on the roadmap that answers from the record — retrieval, never recall. One platform, configured for your field through vertical packs.

packs.heading: One platform, many fields
packs.intro: A pack gives the platform its corpus, its templates, and its workflow for one field. The engine — ingestion, anchoring, grounding, audit — never changes.

list.body: Matter management, document intelligence, deadline rules with citations, and drafting with a human checkpoint — for firms, corporate legal departments, and government agencies.
list.name: Vision Law

list.body: Plan review and code questions answered against your municipal code and adopted standards, with the same page-level traceability.
list.name: Permitting & Code

list.body: If your work runs on documents and rules, a pack is corpus + templates + workflow on the same platform. Nothing about the engine is legal-specific.
list.name: Your field

platform.heading: One pipeline, from paper to proof

steps.body: Bulk uploads are scanned, validated, and read — every page OCR'd with per-page confidence, low-confidence pages flagged for a human instead of silently trusted.
steps.title: Ingest & OCR

steps.body: Documents live as immutable, versioned pages. A fact is never just text — it carries the document, the version, and the page it sits on.
steps.title: Page-anchored store

steps.body: Your codes, statutes, manuals, and records form the corpus the platform answers from — scoped per organization, fenced by permissions.
steps.title: A corpus you define

steps.body: On the roadmap: an agent that retrieves from that corpus and cites its pages. What it cannot ground, it marks as a gap — it never fills silence with invention.
steps.title: A grounded agent

steps.body: Generated documents are assembled from your templates and the record, then published as immutable, gapless versions that a person reviews in the workflow.
steps.title: Drafts a human approves

steps.body: Every view, edit, share, and export lands in an append-only audit trail — enforced by the database, not by policy.
steps.title: Audit over everything

items.body: Every action is recorded in a hash-chained log the database itself refuses to rewrite. If it isn't logged, it didn't happen.
items.title: Append-only audit

items.body: Versioned retention policies with legal holds that block deletion and disposition — and a tombstone when destruction is approved under dual control.
items.title: Retention that holds

items.body: Organizations, teams, and per-record grants. People see exactly what they are granted — denial never leaks existence.
items.title: Access with fences

items.body: Full export of your original files at any time, delivered as an encrypted package with a signed manifest. No lock-in, no hostage data.
items.title: Your data stays yours

themes.switcher_note: All 25 sets are defined and completeness-tested. Light sets (marked light: true) are defined but held out of the production switcher until 013-O02 is decided.
